# ADVANCED QUESTIONS - Detailed Physics and Complex Processes

ADVANCED|30|What physical principle prevents further compression in electron degenerate matter?|Pauli exclusion principle|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What evolutionary track does a star follow when fully convective during pre-main sequence?|Hayashi track|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What is the approximate mass range for stars that undergo electron capture supernovae?|8 to 12 solar masses|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What nuclear process begins immediately before oxygen fusion in massive stars?|Neon burning|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What decay chain provides energy to Type II supernova light curves weeks after explosion?|Nickel-56 to Cobalt-56 to Iron-56|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What causes pair-instability supernovae in the most massive stars?|Photon pair production reducing pressure support|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What physical process converts protons to neutrons during core collapse?|Electron capture|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|Why does the virial theorem require core heating during gravitational contraction?|Half of gravitational energy heats the core, half is radiated away|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What is the main reason stellar evolution is more predictive than star formation theory?|Stars are in hydrostatic equilibrium with well-defined boundary conditions|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What causes the steep mass-luminosity relation on the zero-age main sequence?|Higher core temperature and pressure in more massive stars|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What happens to stellar radius during contraction along the Hayashi line?|Radius decreases while luminosity decreases|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What mass limit separates stars that become white dwarfs from those that explode?|Approximately 8 solar masses initial mass|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What process makes Type Ia supernovae useful as standard candles in cosmology?|They have nearly uniform peak luminosity|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|Why can iron not provide energy through nuclear fusion in stellar cores?|Iron has the highest binding energy per nucleon|TEXT
ADVANCED|30|What prevents low-mass red dwarfs from becoming red giants?|They remain fully convective and burn hydrogen throughout their entire mass|TEXT
